case_goal: Verify that a user can change the calendar filter (area selection) and toggle the view from day to week in the MRBS system.
summary: Log in as admin, navigate to the day view for area 2, then change the area to 3, and finally switch the view from day to week.

steps.expected_result: Login page opens with title 'Meeting Room Booking System' and visible username/password fields.
Login succeeds, page shows admin panel with navigation links ('Rooms', 'Users', etc.) and logged-in user 'admin'.
Navigated to day view for area 2 on 2026-05-03 (URL: index.php?view=day&area=2&page_date=2026-05-03).
View changes to week view for area 3 on 2026-05-04 (URL: index.php?view=week&page_date=2026-05-04&area=3).
